summary: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report) on 2 October 2026, batching nine daily "Transaction in Own Shares" announcements dated 21 September through 2 October 2026. Under a buyback authority granted at the 8 May 2025 AGM and standing instructions issued 17 February 2026, IHG repurchased ordinary shares via Goldman Sachs International on the London Stock Exchange, with daily tranches including 80,000 shares on 18 September at an average of $152.4493 and 52,709 shares on 21 September at $153.7636. Shares will be cancelled, reducing issued capital to roughly 147.2 million shares (excluding 5,431,782 held in treasury). No board recommendation or advisor opinion applies; the program is a routine capital-return mechanic, so no deal/risk-arb angle, though the shrinking float and cancellation cadence bear watching.
